subject: Might as well blame AI for this giant Linux release candidate, says Linus Torvalds

Linus Torvalds joked we might as well blame AI for the chunky Linux 7.3 release candidate.
Evidence: Linux 7.3-rc1 adds 560k lines, AI bug-scanning tools active, human code patches.
#Linux #OpenSource #AI

Torvalds humorously attributes the bloated release candidate size to AI code generation trends in modern software development.

AI is accelerating bug discovery across massive repositories without replacing human architectural oversight.
